$comment: MIRROR of /shared/content-routes.json. The CMS Docker build context is this directory only, so the shared file cannot be reached at build time. content-routes-sync.test.ts (frontend) fails if this drifts from the source of truth. When adding a content type, edit /shared/content-routes.json AND copy the change here.

patternSyntax.{<contentTypeAlias>.slug}: slug of an ancestor with that content type alias; resolver returns null/'#' if the ancestor cannot be found
